question: Which of the following is **NOT **a tributary of the Krishna river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Veena**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Krishna river is an east-flowing river that originates in Mahabaleshwar, Maharashtra. 

 
 
• It flows from Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The length of the river is around 1401 km long.
 
• It is the fourth largest river in India after Ganga, Godavari, and Brahmaputra.
 
• The left bank tributaries of Krishna are Bhima, Dindi, Paleru, and Musi.
 
• Whereas its right bank tributaries are Koyana, Panchganga, Dudhganga, Malprabha, Ghatprabha, and Tungabhadra.
 
 
 
• Tungabhadra is the largest tributary river of Krishna.

Krishna river basin :

• Koyna River:

 
 
• The Koyna River is a tributary of the Krishna River that originates in Mahabaleshwar, Satara district, Western Maharashtra, India.
 
• It rises near the famous hill station Mahabaleshwar in the Western Ghats.
 
• Koyna River is famous for Koyna Dam and Koyna Hydroelectric Project.​
 
 
 
• Ghataprabha River:
 
 
• It originates from the** Western Ghats** and is one of the important tributaries of the Krishna river.
 
• It flows **283 km** before joining the Krishna River at** Chikksangam**.
 
• **Hidkal dam** was constructed across the Ghataprabha river.
 
 

 
• Panchganga

 
 
• This river is the main river on the right bank of Krishna.
 
• It is formed by five rivers. Hence it is called Panchganga. (**Kubhi, Kasari, Tulsi, Bhogavati and Saraswati**)
 
• This river originates at **Bhogavati** in the** Dudhganga hill **range of **Kolhapur district**.
 
• The length of the Panchganga river is 83 km.
 
• Panchganga river is known as the lifeline of the Kolhapur district.
 
• Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj built Radhanagari (**Lakshmisagar**) reservoir on the **Bhogavati** river which is the source stream of Panchganga.
